Dry cable runs through the sturdy bead chain electrode of the Spark Tester and is exposed to the selected test voltages. According to various applications and standards, PURETRONICS offers **LIVE SPARK**, **ACUTE SPARK**, and **DC SPARK TESTER**, which are generally installed after the cooling end in the extrusion line, inspection line, rewinding line, or coiling to detect faults (i.e., bare patches, pin holes, or shearing of electrical wire and cables). Extensively used for power cable, control cable, telecom cable, LAN cable, RF Cable, automotive wire, and building wire. Faults detected can be counted and data can be logged for future reference in order to increase the quality and maximise the efficiency. For easy understanding and fast decoding, data logging graphical representation is also available. For quality assurance, various standard electrodes are available such as IS, UL, and many more. A directly mounted interface display unit for simple operator control (such as display of instrument status, test voltage, and other parameters) is available. > **Image Description:** A process flow diagram illustrating a typical cable extrusion line. The sequence flows from left to right: Pay-Off (Input Drum) ➔ Preheater ➔ Extruder ➔ Cooling Trough ➔ **Spark Tester** (highlighted as a standalone scanning unit on the line) ➔ Output Capstan ➔ Tension Controller ➔ Windup Drum. --- ## 1. IOT Accessories & Stages ### Accessory 1: STAGE-1 (Fault Interface) This additional accessory helps the user to check the faults and distinguish between the types of faults (e.g., Bare patch vs. Pin Hole). This device helps to communicate and give the best user interface to understand the types of faults and categorise / represent them in the most effective way. This accessory makes the device communication with the user better and enables the user with better and clear information. **Features:** - Industry 4.0 compliant. - Communication for better integration of system with ERP or other systems. - Bifurcation / Differentiation in types of fault. - Better linking with further processes. ### Accessory 2: STAGE-2 (Data Logging & Graphics) Data logging helps in collection and storing of data over a period to easily analyse specific trends or record the data based on actions in the system network. It enables the tracking of all interactions through which data, files, or applications are stored, accessed, or modified on a storage device. The graphical screen helps the user to better and fast understanding of the process to take quick corrective action. > **Image Description:** A digital bar graph interface displaying "No of Faults" on the Y-axis and "Cable Length \[m\]" on the X-axis (marked from 100 to 800 meters). The graph visually categorizes the concentration of insulation faults across the continuous length of the manufactured cable. **Features:** - Feature to log defects with respect to length (Along with another accessory). - Graphical representation for better user interaction. - Fault v/s Length analysis. - Fault v/s Wall thickness analysis. - Fault v/s Material analysis. - Custom analysis based on job available on special request. - Customisation available for PDF reports. ### Accessory 3: STAGE-3 (Inline Marking System) This is the inline marking system, linking with the sensor or other signal given from outside to indicate the specified place (Defect/Fault part) on long parts. **Features:** - Easy operation. - Marking for visibility of defect position. - Distinguish between types of defect. --- **Global Reach:** Canada, USA, West Indies, Germany, Turkey, Morocco, Nepal, UAE, China, Bangladesh, Thailand, Nigeria, Kenya, Sri Lanka, Singapore, Zambia, South Africa. *NOTE: The information in this catalogue reflects the current technical specifications at the time of print.
